notes: Reuseit sells some items under the margin scheme (VMB) and marks them "Denna produkt säljs enligt vinstmarginalbeskattning". sold.note: What MacBooks actually sold for on Tradera (its "Sålda" filter, ~250 listings). Use the median as a fair price and the middle half as the normal range. Most titles don't state storage, so the 512 GB rows are small samples, and the cards don't show whether every listing sold or just expired.
takeaways: **Each chip generation adds ~1,500–2,500 kr.** 16 GB over 8 GB adds ~1,000 kr, and 512 GB over 256 GB ~1,500 kr.
**M4s hold their value best**, so a used M4 saves less than you would expect.
**Auctions climb.** A low bid with days left says little; expect the final price near the median.
